_note: August 2026 batch: three new programs from primary-source research, approved via research/findings-2026-08.md. Mahanaim (hesder yeshiva, Gush Etzion), Yeshivat Eshtamoa (agricultural yeshiva, resolves the 'Neta Yadicha' ambiguity as a distinct institution from the already-listed Yeshivat Har Shalom), and Midreshet Lindenbaum -- Hadas (the Israeli track, split out of the existing midreshet-lindenbaum entry which remains the overseas/Hadas-Chu"l track -- see prisma/apply-program-additions-2026-08.ts for that row's field updates). Hebrew names for all three are applied separately via research/hebrew-names-2026-08.json + import-hebrew-names.ts, since import-researched.ts does not populate nameHe. No known cross-batch duplicates.

yeshivot.name: Yeshivat Or Torah Machanaim
yeshivot.description: A hesder yeshiva at Migdal Oz in Gush Etzion, part of the Ohr Torah Stone network, built around the motto "Torah, World, Tikkun" (תורה, עולם, תיקון) -- deep, foundational Torah study aimed at existential relevance to students' lives, alongside a Halacha Kollel, a rabbinical-training kollel for the Diaspora, and a higher beit midrash for Jewish thought.
yeshivot.adminNote: Researched Aug 2026 -- see research/findings-2026-08.md. contactEmail (machanaim@ots.org.il) uses the shared @ots.org.il domain (Ohr Torah Stone network) -- possibly an Organization-model candidate rather than a program-owned address; flagged for an admin decision, not acted on here. Duration, cost, and a signup URL were not found on the yeshiva's own site as of this research pass.

yeshivot.name: Yeshivat Eshtamoa
yeshivot.location: Mitzpe Eshtamoa, southern Mount Hebron, Israel
yeshivot.description: An agricultural higher yeshiva and beit midrash ("ישיבה גבוהה ובית מדרש חקלאי"), led by Rabbi Betzalel HaGer, combining advanced Torah study with agricultural work on the southern Mount Hebron ridge.
yeshivot.adminNote: Researched Aug 2026 -- resolves the 'Neta Yadicha/Eshtamoa' ambiguity from this batch's research as a real, DISTINCT institution from the already-listed Yeshivat Har Shalom (different name, different rosh yeshiva -- Rabbi Betzalel HaGer here vs. Rabbi Itzik Idles/Amti there -- and different institutional character: agricultural yeshiva gevoha here vs. hesder there). See research/findings-2026-08.md for the full resolution. Age-range and religious-affiliation tags deliberately left unassigned -- the source doesn't state whether this serves gap-year-age students or an older/mixed population typical of some agricultural yeshivot gevohot; needs an admin who knows the institution to fill in rather than a guess. durationType is a MULTI_YEAR category default (advanced yeshiva, not a fixed gap-year track), also worth an admin's confirmation. Newest dated site content is Dec 2024 (~20 months old at import time) -- under the 2-year staleness bar but the most dated source in this batch, worth a periodic recheck. contactPhone/contactEmail are the yeshiva's general office line, not a personal number -- retained from the campus's prior occupant per the office's own listing.

yeshivot.name: Midreshet Lindenbaum — Hadas
yeshivot.organization: Midreshet Lindenbaum (OU Israel / Ohr Torah Stone network)
yeshivot.description: The flagship program of Midreshet Lindenbaum for Israeli high-school graduates, integrating a year of deep Torah study (Tanach, Talmud, Halacha, and Jewish thought) with three years of IDF service in the Education Corps, Intelligence Corps, or Air Force. Includes biweekly in-person support sessions at military bases during service and Jerusalem-area housing for participants stationed nearby.
yeshivot.durationText: 1 year at the midrasha (Elul–Tammuz), followed by 3 years of IDF service
yeshivot.adminNote: Split from the combined midreshet-lindenbaum entry in Aug 2026 -- this is the Israeli track (full 3-year IDF integration); see that program's own adminNote for the overseas/Hadas Chu"l counterpart it was split from, and research/findings-2026-08.md for the full sourcing that established these are two genuinely distinct tracks sharing the 'Hadas' name.
